Triage: **`pm:queue`** (objectui in-repo card — pm-state only).

**Anchor verification (on `origin/main` @ `c852682`)**: `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/block-config.ts` — the `record:details` sections `itemFields` array carries exactly `label` / `columns` / `fields` and no `name` (verified at `:310-321` region). The renderer's i18n anchor read (`record-details.tsx`, `sectionLabel(objectName, s.name, …)`) and the `plugin-detail` input description that now documents `name` as the i18n anchor (post-#3807) are both live at this ref — so the designer demonstrably cannot author the key the renderer and lint (`translation-section-name-missing`) expect.

**Why queue**: concrete defect, single named landing site, fix is one added `itemField`. The two open sub-questions (snake_case validation / derive-from-label; empty-vs-backfill on open) are implementation-level choices reviewable in the PR — neither changes a public contract.

**Dedup**: #3134 is the neighboring designer surface (form layout), different design face; #3807 changed the published description, not the designer. No duplicate.

本评论来自分诊座位 Routine（#5474 试点），不构成认领。

- 分支:`claude/issue-3819-sections-name-field`
- 修法按分诊:`record:details.sections` 的 `itemFields` 补 `name`(`kind: 'text'`,i18n 锚点);两个子问题按分诊定性为**实现级选择**,dev 判后在 PR 里说明 —— ① snake_case 校验/从 label 派生(派生须避免把已翻译 label 变锚点,倾向不自动派生只校验或提示);② 既有仅 label 的 section 打开时 `name` 留空不回填(回填有把译文固化成锚点的风险)。两处判断如与实测冲突,以实测为准并报告。
- 文件面:`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/block-config.ts` + 对应测试;浏览器实证设计器真的长出该输入位(worktree 有 scoped verify skill)。
- 与在飞 #3831(plugin-detail/fields)零相交;#3134(表单布局设计面)另单不碰。
